name: Quran Text — Hafs 'an 'Asim (Uthmani Script)
description: Complete Quran text in Uthmani script, Hafs 'an 'Asim, from the Tanzil Project's verified corpus (a faithful digital reproduction of the Madinah Mushaf).

license_notes: 2026-10-14: the canonical text switched from the KFGQPC Hafs file (assets/hafs_smart_v8.json, byte-identical to data/raw/quran_uthmani.json) to Tanzil. KFGQPC's terms grant no redistribution ('may not be reproduced ... without the express written approval'); Tanzil's allow use 'in any website or application' with attribution and a link. A verse-by-verse comparison found the same letters in all 6,236 verses apart from encoding conventions (hamza-alef vs alef-madda; 'بعد ما'/'بعدما' at 2:181, 8:6, 13:37; two encodings of 'يا صاحبي' at 12:39, 12:41), enforced by backend/tests/test_quran_text_source.py. The KFGQPC files stay in the repository only as that cross-reference; they are not seeded, served or bundled.

authority.notes: The Madinah Mushaf (مصحف المدينة النبوية) is the globally recognised reference edition for Hafs an Asim in Uthmani script. The digital text used here faithfully reproduces the rasm and diacritics of that edition via the Tanzil project's verified corpus.
